pages.text: The $(item)Filament Winder$() turns materials into Filament Units. Put a material in the input slot and a $(item)Filament Spool$() in the spool slot.$(br2)One winder handles $(l)every tier$(): the spool decides what it accepts, not the machine.
The Filament Winder: string, sticks, and a smooth-stone base. Craftable from Tier 1.

pages.title: What It Accepts
pages.text: Winding is $(l)exact-tier$(): a material only winds into a spool of its own tier, or the GUI reads $(l)Requires Tier X Spool$().$(br2)Unpriced items read $(l)Can't be converted$(). Trivially farmable drops are held back so they cannot be laundered.$(br2)With $(l)Mystical Agradditions$() the $(item)Nether Star$() and $(item)Dragon Egg$() stop winding. $(l)Without$() it, they wind as always.
